scenario.title: Over-temperature raises a latched fault on the bus
scenario.description: Inject 60.0 C into the pack's hottest-cell reading and require the fault frame, carrying fault_code OVERTEMP, on the bus inside 50 ms. The pack is first observed quiet on that identifier for 100 ms, so a fault frame that arrives afterwards can only be the one the injection caused.

steps.params: pack nominal, watching the fault identifier

params.label: no fault frame while the pack is within limits

steps.params: injecting 60.0 C into the hottest cell

params.label: fault frame reports OVERTEMP within 50 ms

steps.params: temperature back to 25.0 C, the fault must not clear

params.label: fault stays latched after the temperature returns to normal

assertions.label: no fault frame while the pack is within limits
assertions.reason: no matching frame occurred in the window

assertions.label: fault frame reports OVERTEMP within 50 ms
fault stays latched after the temperature returns to normal

run.tier_note: the emulator supports these boards; not verified end to end, so this result is shown and is not authoritative
